statistics_note: Descriptive only. Both replicates are one contiguous 512-row window per crawl/file: clustered, not iid. Protocol section 5 forbids binomial iid confidence intervals, eight-window bootstrap confidence claims and significance claims, so none is reported; uncertainty is shown as per-crawl ranges, spreads and matched-crawl differences.
